author: Lake Forest College Library
rights_note: An archive's authority record, cited in words only.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-30 (T-3251) through a fetch that returned short quoted fragments.
note: Fragments read: 'Eleanor (Nelly, as she wrote it, or Nellie) Lytle Kinzie Gordon was born in Chicago June 18, 1835'; 'daughter of John A. [sic] and Juliette (Magill) Kinzie'; she married William Washington Gordon II; 'Another daughter of Mrs. Gordon's, Juliette Gordon Low, was the founder of the Girl Scouts of the U.S.A.' The page prints the father's middle initial as A.; he is John Harris Kinzie, Juliette Magill Kinzie's husband.
what_it_supplies: Eleanor Lytle Kinzie born in Chicago on 18 June 1835 to John and Juliette Kinzie
her daughter Juliette Gordon Low as founder of the Girl Scouts of the U.S.A.
what_it_does_not_supply: which house in Chicago Eleanor was born in
